title: Expand the Hadamard m-polynomial table at length six

source.citation: Generalizing Krawtchouk polynomials using Hadamard matrices, arXiv:1307.5777

translation.notes: The Mathematica generator for the two-by-two Hadamard matrix at n=6 is formed in Z[z0,z1]. Exact coefficient extraction, preserving the source's displayed exponent-label convention, reconstructs the complete published seven-by-seven m-polynomial table.
